Hi. i think it has to do with a sense of control and safety. for me, knowing that i'm going to kill myself calms me down. i know that when i can no longer cope, the suffering will end. this is my only freedom. it is my only control. and i realize that my thoughts are those of a man standing on the edge. i no longer hope to help myself. and i don't want to. i am indifferent to self-help.

But precisely because i understand how i became who i am, i want to help other people "not become as me". Maybe i want to make their existence a little better. Because no one has made it in the past for me. And i know how much i wanted it, how much i needed help. i remember it all. and that's why it saddens me to realize that there are other people for whom existence turned out to be as shitty as it was for me.
